text: Guys did we finish the discharge calls or is there still a list?
Still 2 left. Mr. Assis (poodle) and the Lima cat. Lima didnt pick up twice
Ok I'll try lima after this one
ICU dog (the lab mix from this morning) still on fluids, pressure ok, pee ok. No vomit since 10
Good. Keep an eye on the bp at 14h
Will do 👍
I'm in the lab room, samples are labeled but I need the courier form. Where is it
Top drawer at the front desk, blue folder. Monday run is 8am?
Yeah 8am pickup
Rosana did mr assis pick up?
Yes he said he'd come tomorrow for the stitches, booked 9:30
Perfect. Lima?
No answer again. Left voicemail. I'll try after 5
Heading out for a bit, need to eat something. Back by 6:30
Ok. Who's on the ICU now
Me, I'm here till 22
Lima called back!! The cat is fine, owner wants pickup tomorrow at 11. Booked
Amazing
Back. Samples in the fridge, I double checked the tube numbers vs the form
ICU dog just woke up and is trying to get off the blanket lol. He's ok I think, finally awake
Great. Dont let him stand on the drip
Already on it
I'm home now. Tell me if anything changes with the dog, I'll be up
Will do
Leaving now. Handed the ICU to gabriel, he has the sheet and the 2am check. Bp was 110 at 21h
Got it. 2am check, if he vomits do I call vanessa?
Yes call me
Dog's temp 37.4, all calm
Goodnight all
2am check done. Temp 37.8, bp 105. He tried to chew the drip line, I moved it. No vomit
Ok good. Call if anything changes
Up early for the courier. Samples still in the fridge
On my way, 15 min. Dog ok?
Ate a little. Peed at 5
[photo: courier form, signed]
Got it. Who's collecting
Driver at 8:20. Tube numbers match the form
Morning. Mr Assis at 9:30 still and Lima at 11?
Yes both. Rosana can you put Lima on the board
Already did
Dog's bp 118, pee good, eating a bit
Mr Assis is here. Thiago you free for the stitches?
Coming now
Stitches out, wound clean, he's fine. Owner asked if the dog can go home Tuesday
Not until bloods are back. I'll check at lunch
Lima's owner is here early with the carrier
Coming, 5 min
Dog's bloods are fine, creatinine down. Maybe discharge Tue morning if he keeps eating
Nice 👍
Back from lunch. Anything for the ICU before I start the afternoon?
Just fluids to 50%, no other changes
Someone from the bank called about the card machine receipts. Who do I send them to
Me. Forward it
Leaving at 18. Who has the ICU tonight?
I do till 22. Then whoever
I can come back at 21 if you need me
Ok, I'll call if so
[photo: Lima the cat in his carrier, owner sent it]
Looks very annoyed
Dog temp 37.9, all calm. Will check again at 1
Ok. Goodnight
1am check. Temp 37.6, bp 108. Quiet
Ok
Dog peed at 5 again. Ate a little at 6
Here. Dog ok?
Yeah he's ok
Running 30 min late. Thiago can you do the 8am bp when you're settled
Ok
Morning. Lima at 11 still. Dog's owner asking what time he can pick up
Tell him after my check, around 13 if bp and appetite are fine
Here. Ok dog can go home today. Thiago please do discharge sheet and meds
I'm off at 9. Anything else before I go
Nothing, thanks for the nights
Lima's owner called, asking if the carrier needs to be bigger. Don't know what to tell him
Tell him it's fine, he just needs the cat in it
Lol ok
Lima's owner here. Cat is NOT happy with the carrier. 10 min of fighting
Pics or it didn't happen
[photo: Lima half out of the carrier, ears flat]
😂 poor thing
Dog bp 112, eating a full bowl. Ok for discharge at 13
Nice. Owner coming at 13 then
Card machine jammed again. Anyone know how to reset it or do I call the bank
Unplug it 10 sec and plug back in. If not, bank. I'm in a spay at 2, phone off till 3
Worked!
Dog discharged. Owner happy. Meds on the sheet
Booked his check for next Tue 15 Dec 10am
Going in now
Can someone cover Thursday evening for me? Exam Friday morning
I can do Thursday if you do Saturday
Deal
Spay done, all good. Who's here tonight
Nobody. ICU is empty and I left at 17
Ok. Lock up
Night all
Night
